Design a compact quadcopter for everyday aerial photography. Strict orthographic top view, nose toward the top edge, arms fully unfolded.
Match the four motor centres and arm directions in the layout. True X, 250 mm opposite-motor span, equal horizontal and vertical spacing. Each motor carries one stationary two-blade, 5-inch propeller. No propeller guards.
A rounded pod with a continuous curved outline.
Each arm grows out of the shell through a smooth seamless blend, with no joint line at the root.
The nose shell wraps around the camera; from directly overhead only the smooth top of the nose is seen, with no gimbal arms or side lugs. The camera faces horizontally forward.
One top cover seam.
Matte light grey shell, dark grey arms and motors, black propellers.
Show the complete product on a plain light background. Omit guide marks and lettering.
